brief:
Former Israeli soldiers deceived people in New York City by posing as pro-Palestinian supporters, according to Al Jazeera English. The undercover operation involved the soldiers engaging with members of the public while misrepresenting their identities and affiliations to gain access to activist spaces.

The soldiers' specific objectives for the deception remain unclear from available reporting. The incident raises broader questions about covert infiltration tactics and the authenticity of political organizing spaces in the United States, particularly those centered on Palestinian rights advocacy. It underscores tensions between Israeli security interests and transparency in public activism.
dek: Former Israeli soldiers posed as pro-Palestinian supporters in New York City to deceive people into engaging with them.
title: Former Israeli soldiers pose as pro-Palestinian activists in New York
